title: neottia spiralis
intro: Neottia spiralis, commonly known as the twisted adder's tongue orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and alleviating respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Neottia spiralis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Neottia spiralis also exhibit antimicrobial and hepatoprotective activities, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
